question: I'm reading https://dealectric.com/power-station-for-cpap — Which power station on this list is the quietest to keep next to my bed?
query: dealectric.com/power-station-for-cpap quietest power station fan noise CPAP

replays.text:
The quietest one I can verify is the **Bluetti Elite 100 V2**: a tester measured it at **34 dBA at one metre** under a much heavier load than a CPAP, and said they didn’t notice its fan overnight ([test details](https://solarpowerauditor.com/camping/best-power-station-cpap/)).

I can’t confirm from the available details whether it’s one of the models on [Dealectric’s list](https://dealectric.com/power-station-for-cpap). If it is, it’s the strongest bedside-quiet pick I can substantiate.

I can’t verify the quietest model **on Dealectric’s list** from the available page details—the listing snippet doesn’t include noise measurements. [Dealectric’s guide](https://dealectric.com/power-station-for-cpap)

For comparison, a separate test named the **Bluetti Elite 100 V2** its quietest CPAP pick, measuring **34 dBA at about 500 W** and saying it was barely noticeable overnight. That doesn’t confirm it’s the quietest model on Dealectric’s list, though. [Test results](https://solarpowerauditor.com/camping/best-power-station-cpap/)

I can’t verify a “quietest” pick from [Dealectric’s list](https://dealectric.com/power-station-for-cpap): the page information available to me says it compares 17 models, but doesn’t show noise measurements.

As a useful benchmark, a separate tested roundup measured the **Bluetti Elite 100 V2** at **34 dBA at one metre** and described it as barely audible in a bedroom—but I can’t confirm it’s on Dealectric’s list. ([Test results](https://solarpowerauditor.com/camping/best-power-station-cpap/)) For the quietest setup, using a compatible **DC power cable** for your CPAP can avoid running the station’s AC inverter, which may keep its fan off. ([CPAP guide](https://stationarena.com/cpap))
